mysqld_bind_address.description: IP address MySQL listens on. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces (ensure firewall is configured).

mysqld_port.description: TCP port for MySQL server connections.

mysqld_datadir.description: Directory where MySQL stores table data and system databases.

mysqld_thread_cache_size.description: Number of threads MySQL keeps cached for reuse. Higher values reduce thread creation overhead under high connection churn.

mysqld_max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

mysqld_wait_timeout.description: Number of seconds the server waits for activity on a non-interactive connection before closing it.

mysqld_max_allowed_packet.description: Maximum size of a single packet or any generated/intermediate string. Must be a number + unit (e.g., 64M, 256M).

mysqld_innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: Size of the buffer pool used to cache InnoDB data and indexes. For dedicated DB servers, set to ~70–80% of RAM.

mysqld_innodb_log_file_size.description: Size of each InnoDB log file in the log group. Larger values improve performance but increase crash recovery time.

mysqld_innodb_flush_method.description: Method used to flush data to InnoDB data files and logs. Common: fsync, O_DIRECT.

mysqld_query_cache_type.description: Query cache behavior: 0=OFF, 1=ON, 2=DEMAND. (Deprecated in MySQL 8.0+; leave empty to omit.)

mysqld_query_cache_size.description: Total size of the query cache (deprecated in MySQL 8.0+; leave empty to omit.)

mysqld_character_set_server.description: Default character set for new databases and tables.

mysqld_collation_server.description: Default collation for the server (must match the character set).

mysqld_ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for MySQL connections.

mysqld_ssl_ca.description: Path to the CA certificate file for SSL (required if SSL enabled).

mysqld_ssl_cert.description: Path to the server certificate file for SSL.

mysqld_ssl_key.description: Path to the server private key file for SSL.

mysqld_slow_query_log_enabled.description: Enable slow query logging (for performance analysis).

mysqld_slow_query_log_file.description: Path to the slow query log file.

mysqld_long_query_time.description: Threshold in seconds for queries to be logged as slow.

mysqld_binlog_enabled.description: Enable binary logging (required for replication and point-in-time recovery).

mysqld_binlog_path.description: Base name/path for binary log files (without extension).

mysqld_binlog_format.description: Binary log format: STATEMENT, ROW, or MIXED. ROW is safest for replication.

mysqld_expire_logs_days.description: Number of days after which binary logs are automatically purged.

mysqld_server_id.description: Unique server ID (1–4294967295). Required for replication; must be unique per server in the topology.

items.description: Name of a database to explicitly replicate (master-side filter).

mysqld_replicate_do_db.description: List of databases to replicate (used in replication master config).

items.description: Name of a database to skip during replication.

mysqld_replicate_ignore_db.description: List of databases to ignore during replication.

mysqld_custom_vars.description: Free-form key-value pairs for additional runtime variables (e.g., tmp_table_size, join_buffer_size).

client_port.description: Default port used by MySQL client tools.

client_character_set.description: Default character set for MySQL client connections.
